name: MotoGP Predictions
summary: Sprint and Grand Prix forecasts for the MotoGP world championship.
description: Scaffolded on the shared MotorsportVerse core with working seams: a snapshot-backed DataSource implementing the core calendar/grid/results contract, a leakage-guarded prior-form Predictor, and a contract test suite asserting that nothing is fabricated while no feed is wired. A GP weekend carries two scoring races sharing one qualifying, so the F2/F3 feeder template is the clone source — but the sprint grid is NOT reversed here. See the project README.
